articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Vision, and Audio
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can jointly process code repositories, visual diagrams, and spoken instructions in a single inference pass. Benchmarks show a 38% improvement on SWE-Bench over GPT-5 base, with dramatically reduced hallucination rates. The model is available via API with a new streaming architecture that cuts time-to-first-token latency by half.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Mathematical Olympiad Problems
articles.summary: DeepMind announced Gemini Ultra 2, which scored a gold-medal equivalent on the 2026 International Mathematical Olympiad problem set, solving 5 out of 6 problems with fully rigorous proofs. The system uses a novel chain-of-verification approach where separate model instances critique and formally verify each proof step. This marks the first time an AI system has matched top human competitors on the full, unmodified competition.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Pilot Deployment in Amazon Fulfillment Centers
articles.summary: Amazon confirmed a pilot program deploying 1,000 Tesla Optimus Gen 3 humanoid robots across three fulfillment centers in Texas and Ohio, handling bin picking, shelf stocking, and package sorting. The robots leverage on-device vision-language models for zero-shot object manipulation, reportedly achieving 95% grasp success rates on novel items. The partnership signals a significant step toward commercially viable general-purpose humanoid labor.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Now Performs Autonomous Construction Tasks on Real Job Sites
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics demonstrated its electric Atlas robot autonomously performing drywall carrying, tool retrieval, and debris clearing on an active construction site in partnership with Skanska. The system uses a combination of LiDAR mapping, real-time path planning, and a foundation model fine-tuned on construction workflows to interpret foreman instructions in natural language. Union and safety regulators are closely monitoring the trial, which is the first permitted autonomous humanoid operation on a US construction site.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces 'Constitutional Classifiers' Framework to Dramatically Reduce Jailbreak Success Rates
articles.summary: Anthropic published research on a new Constitutional Classifiers system that wraps generative models in a layered defense combining input/output classifiers trained via constitutional AI principles with runtime interpretability checks. In red-team evaluations, jailbreak success rates dropped below 0.3% across all tested attack categories, a 10x improvement over previous guardrails. The framework is open-sourced and designed to be model-agnostic, applicable to any transformer-based LLM.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Gate-All-Around Chips for AI Accelerators
articles.summary: TSMC announced it has entered volume production on its N1.4 process node using gate-all-around (GAA) nanosheet transistors, with NVIDIA and Broadcom as lead customers for next-generation AI accelerator chips. The node delivers a 25% performance gain and 35% power reduction versus the N2 node, enabling inference chips that can run 400-billion-parameter models within a 300W thermal envelope. Analysts expect these chips to ship in AI server platforms by Q1 2027.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate First Fault-Tolerant Logical Qubit Operations at Scale
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum jointly demonstrated 48 logical qubits with error rates below the fault-tolerance threshold, executing a 200-gate quantum circuit with 99.8% fidelity on their trapped-ion platform. This milestone overcomes the primary obstacle to practical quantum computing by showing that error correction overhead can be managed at scale. The companies announced a cloud-accessible quantum computing service launching in early 2027 targeting molecular simulation and optimization workloads.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C to Scale Humanoid Robot Manufacturing, Valued at $15B
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a $1.5 billion Series C round led by Microsoft and Intel Capital, bringing its valuation to $15 billion, as the company plans to build a dedicated humanoid robot factory in South Carolina with a target annual capacity of 10,000 units. The Figure 03 platform features a new proprietary actuator design that cuts production costs by 40% compared to its predecessor. The funding underscores investor confidence that humanoid robotics is transitioning from research curiosity to industrial-scale deployment.
